name: harness-academy
description: An interactive course that teaches coding-agent harness architecture by making you rebuild one.

scripts.content: uv run python course/scripts/export_content.py && cp runtime/test_runner.py public/content/test_runner.py
scripts.test:python: PYTHONPATH=course/src uv run python -m pytest course/workbench/tests/ -q -p no:cacheprovider
scripts.check: npm test && npm run build:ci && npm run test:browser
